tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0126 ↗ topping-ch10-hamilton-theorem 1. ch10:1.2\group positive-ricci-three-manifolds

Every closed Riemannian three-manifold with positive Ricci curvature admits a metric of constant positive sectional curvature. If it is simply connected, then it is $S^3$.
